entities.name: Angel's Keep
entities.description: Castle fortress built by Xarl in the Wolf's Hackle in Golthonor on Corondor, where the fallen angel Trine was imprisoned.

entities.name: Xarl
entities.description: Archmage Xarl Angel-Keeper, builder of Angel's Keep.

entities.name: Mandek Ironfist
entities.description: Warlord of the Iron Kingdom who granted the tower to Xarl.

entities.name: Trine
entities.description: Fallen angel imprisoned in the keep who escaped after Xarl's death.

events.summary: Warlord Mandek Ironfist granted the tower in the Wolf's Hackle to Xarl during the Time of Legends.
events.quote: granted to Xarl by Warlord Mandek Ironfist of the Iron Kingdom

events.summary: Trine escaped the keep after Xarl's death, greatly damaging it.
events.quote: the keep was greatly damaged when Trine escaped after Xarl's death

relations.quote: Warlord Mandek Ironfist of the Iron Kingdom
